role: The app's one hard wall clock for async work (strap SDK calls, geocoding, workout finalization, the CloudKit remote delete): Deadline.race runs the operation in its own Task and resumes the caller at the first of result (value or the operation's own error), deadline (the given timeout error) or caller cancellation (CancellationError), dropping late results; runWithTimeout is its value-or-nil form; FirstResultGate resumes a continuation once for the CloudKit progress watchdog.
types: DeadlineRace<T>: class (private, Sendable) — lock-protected continuation + clock/call tasks + cancelled flag
ResumeOnce<T>: class (private, Sendable) — resumes a CheckedContinuation at most once

units.does: Creates a DeadlineRace and suspends on a checked throwing continuation that the race resumes once: with the operation's value or thrown error, with `timeout` when `seconds` pass first, or with CancellationError at once when the calling task is cancelled (onCancel → race.cancel()). Never waits for the operation to stop.
units.entry: Called from RRCollector+OvernightArming.swift, PolarManager+Recording.swift, StrapRecordingCoordinator+Transfer.swift; test StrapTransferTests.swift.

units.does: 'no result within <seconds> s': the reason runWithTimeout logs when the deadline passed.

Returns Deadline.race(seconds, timeout: DeadlineExpired(seconds), operation); on any thrown error (the deadline, the operation's own error, or the caller's cancellation, which resumes it at once) logs '[runWithTimeout] no result: <reason>' and returns nil.

branches.cond: Deadline.race threw (deadline, operation error or caller cancellation)
branches.effect: log the reason and return nil; otherwise the value

units.does: Wraps the continuation in an OSAllocatedUnfairLock.
True once the stored continuation has been taken (resume called).
Atomically takes the continuation out of the lock and resumes it with the value; later calls find nil and do nothing.

Stores the ResumeOnce; if already cancelled resumes CancellationError; else starts a clock Task (expire) and a call Task (run), records both, and if cancel() ran meanwhile calls cancel() again so the new tasks get cancelled.

branches.effect: true: resumes with CancellationError and returns without starting tasks; false: starts clock and call tasks

branches.cond: cancelled flag set while tasks were being created
branches.effect: true: cancel() resumes (no-op if already resumed) and cancels both tasks; false: nothing

units.does: Marks the race cancelled, resumes the caller with CancellationError (ignored if already resumed), and cancels the clock and call tasks.
units.entry: withTaskCancellationHandler onCancel in Deadline.race (caller's task cancelled, e.g. user Cancel on a strap transfer).

units.does: Sleeps `seconds` (a TimeInterval, negative taken as zero); if the sleep is cancelled (call finished first) returns silently; otherwise resumes the caller with `timeout` and cancels both tasks.

branches.effect: catch: return silently — expected when the operation finished first; no throw: deadline reached, caller resumed with timeout

units.does: Awaits the operation, resumes the caller with its value or error, then cancels the clock task.
calls: closure:operation passed by Deadline.race callers (strap SDK calls, map and geocoder lookups, HealthKit queries, the CloudKit remote delete)

branches.effect: catch: caller resumed with that error (dropped if deadline/cancel already resumed); no throw: resumed with value

units.does: Resumes the continuation with the result only the first time (setIfClear on `resumed`); later results are dropped.
units.entry: Invoked as a function by DeadlineRace.begin/cancel/expire/run.

branches.effect: true: continuation resumed with the result; false: result dropped
